name: Smart MultiEgg
author: canhphung@users.noreply.github.com
description: One policy-aware launcher for Minecraft Java, proxies, Bedrock, Node.js, Python and Lavalink. No Panel modifications or arbitrary startup commands.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
install -d -m 0750 /mnt/server/.multiegg
echo '[MULTIEGG] Control directory initialized.'
